verdict.rationale: Channel3 is API-first. Its core capabilities are documented as API operations, mirrored by an official SDK, CLI and MCP server: text, image and URL search, filters, URL product lookup, agentic search mode, price-tracking webhooks and affiliate user attribution. However, nothing explicitly claims or demonstrates parity with the web UI, and account-level functions are not shown as API-accessible. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage of account management (API key creation, billing and credits, webhook subscription management), a published OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
